final:

2. For each owner user, get their conversations (channels) via users.conversations with types=public_channel,private_channel (channels only — mpim/im are DMs, not channels).
3. For each channel, check whether created < March 2026 (i.e., created before 2026-03-01) and num_members == 5.
4. Archive the matching channel.
